prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sync & Secure Your Companion", "Sign in to save your pet safely in the cloud so your progress is never lost.", "Cloud Save Active"]
1: ["Use well-lit, clear front-facing photos for best pet generation results."]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Click your pet to play, right-click for settings, and drag to reposition anytime.", "Left-click: Interact | Right-click: Options | Drag: Move"]
3: ["Assembling Your Desktop Companion", "We are generating custom assets and preparing your pet."]
4: []
5: ["Companion Active on Desktop", "Your companion is live on your screen. Check your desktop background or system tray."]
6: ["Quick Account Connection", "Link your account in seconds to sync companion progress across all your devices.", "Continue to Pet Setup"]
7: ["Personalize Adoption Badge", "Name your companion and select your official adoption seal.", "Pet Name"]
8: ["Choose Your Companion Path", "Pick a path to unlock a free starter hat accessory for your desktop pet!", "Includes Free Accessory"]
9: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a desktop alert when your pet is ready!"]
